flow: Environmental Ebola virus pathogens (U)->Environmental Ebola virus pathogens (U)
param: α₁ Recruitment rate into susceptible people (A)
α₂ Recruitment rate into infectious people (P)
ψ₁ Effective contact rate with infectious humans (P) contributing to infection of susceptibles
ψ₂ Effective contact rate with environmental Ebola pathogens (U) contributing to infection of susceptibles
ψ₃ Effective contact rate with deceased humans (S) contributing to infection of susceptibles
ε Natural death rate of humans
ρ₁ Death rate of infected humans due to infection (disease-induced mortality from P to S)
ρ₂ Shedding rate of infected humans into the environment (from P to U)
ρ₃ Quarantine rate of infected people (from P to F)
w₁ Recovery rate of quarantined people (from F to K)
w₂ Death rate of quarantined people (from F to S)
h Shedding rate (or contribution) of deceased people to environmental pathogens (from S to U)
c Burial/removal rate of deceased people (outflow from S)
b Decay/removal rate of Ebola pathogens in the environment (outflow from U)
d Input/source term for Ebola pathogens in the environment (inflow to U)
ζ Conformable fractional derivative order (used as t^(ζ-1) multiplier in the paper)
